blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu – A 38-year-old man was killed and two others were injured in one of two fires that broke out in Lapu-Lapu City Sunday night, November 1. Both fires destroyed 23 homes, according to an advisory released by Mayor Cindi King-Chan on Monday morning, November 2. King-Chan said relief efforts were ongoing to assist the fire victims.
